text:
Maya: Quick kickoff — 2-week dev-content sprint for OSS reference app + tutorial series.
Alex: 👍 What are the top deliverables? blog post, tutorial video, starter repo, benchmark notes?
Maya: Yep. Minimal launch: 1) blog post w/benchmarks, 2) 2 tutorials (getting started + integrations), 3) refapp repo with sample infra, 4) webinar for devs.
Priya: I'll own the blog post + narrative. Need benchmark numbers from eng by Fri EOD.
Jorge: eng can deliver perf numbers. Which workloads? chat latency + throughput + cost per 1k tokens.
Maya: prioritize "low-latency chat" and "batch embeddings" — show cost delta vs naive config. Simple tables + 1 chart.
Linh: I'll draft tutorial outlines. prefer two flows: local quickstart (Docker) and cloud deploy (Redwood Dedicated example).
Ben: I'll spin up a refapp skeleton repo today, add CI and deploy scripts. Can we standardize infra as Terraform + docker-compose?
Alex: Terraform + simple Dockerfile + README. Keep secrets stubbed. Use sample prompt sets for eval.
Priya: For the blog, tone = developer-first, cost-conscious. Call out routing and cache tips from the platform. Add a short "how we measured" section.
Jorge: Sending a quick containerized benchmark script: ```bash
# run locally
python bench.py --model small --seq 512 --concurrency 8
```
Linh: For tutorials, include code snippets and a small troubleshooting section (KV cache warmup, batching tips).
Maya: Timeline: draft content by Thu, internal review Fri, imaging + final edits Mon, publish Wed. Webinar two weeks after publish.
Alex: Webinar add: demo refapp + Q&A + live perf run. Need speakers: Jorge (perf), Priya (messaging), Ben (repo tour).
Ben: I can demo CI and deploy. Need 20–30 minute demo + 10 min Q&A. Will prepare slides.
Priya: Inbound routing — capture leads via GH action + signup form on blog. Marketing will wire up HubSpot form; Devrel to add a CTA in README.
Maya: Good. Action items: Priya: blog draft + CTAs; Jorge: benchmark numbers + scripts; Ben: refapp skeleton; Linh: tutorial outlines; Alex: webinar logistics.
Alex: I'll create calendar invite and hubspot forms, and add tracking params for ads.
Priya: Small UX ask: include "try on Redwood" button that opens playground with example prompt.
Maya: Nice. Let's keep judgement minimal for launch. If anything slips, we'll cut one tutorial and publish a followup.
release-bot: deploy-notice: New refapp repo created by Ben in #dev-content at 1759001150
Ben: Repo pushed — initial skeleton, README, and CI. link: https://github.com/redwood/refapp-sample
Maya: Great progress. Next sync: Thurs 11am PT in #marketing. Standups in thread please.
Alex: noted.
Priya: will share blog draft in thread when ready.
Jorge: benchmark results ETA Thu morning.
